visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a purple sweatshirt with a graphic, sits in an indoor room. Behind her are bookshelves filled with books and a window with blinds. Above her, a split-screen displays a still from a live-action movie trailer featuring a woman in a blue and yellow dress. (2) The young woman in the bottom frame looks at the camera, nodding her head slightly. The top screen begins displaying various YouTube user comments overlaid on the trailer still. (3) The young woman reacts to the comments by smiling and laughing, sometimes covering her mouth with her hand or gesturing with both hands. The top screen continues to cycle through different text boxes containing humorous social media comments. (4) She briefly holds up a round paper prop with a graphic of an animated villain (the Evil Queen). The background environment remains consistent with soft, warm indoor lighting. (5) The woman continues her reaction, looking back and forth between the camera and presumably the screen she is watching, expressing amusement through facial expressions and hand movements until the video ends.
